name: altimate-code
description: Gives Claude Code altimate-code's model-free data tools (column-level lineage, impact analysis, PII detection, data-diff, FinOps, query equivalence, dialect translation, warehouse queries) through its MCP server, or through `altimate tool run` when MCP servers are not allowed, with delegation to the altimate-code agent for long dbt jobs, access to a linked Altimate workspace's knowledge, and the workspace's team rules in each session.

maxScanBytes.title: Largest BigQuery scan without asking
maxScanBytes.description: A dbt run, build or show that BigQuery estimates would scan more bytes than this is held until you allow it with /allow-scan. 0 never holds one. Other warehouses are never held.

healthBlocksPush.title: Project health blocks git push
healthBlocksPush.description: When on, git push is refused while the project health check finds new issues in the models you changed. Off, the issues are only shown.

healthConfigPath.title: Project health check config
healthConfigPath.description: Path to a DataPilot health check config file, relative to the dbt project. Empty uses the default checks.

commentsPollSeconds.title: Team comments refresh (seconds)
commentsPollSeconds.description: How often the team's comments on shared docs are fetched again.

commentsInContext.title: Team comments in Claude's context
commentsInContext.description: When on, the open comments on a model Claude reads or edits are added to its context. Off keeps them out of Claude's context.
